description: Create a forward PURCHASE ORDER to a vendor — a draft (status "created") an operator then issues. Give the vendor, the destination warehouse, and the lines to buy; each line names an item (by itemSku OR itemId) and a quantity, with an optional unitCost (omit it to price from the vendor's price book, then the item's catalog cost, then its last purchase cost — each preview line names its costSource) and optional line expense. Payment terms default to the vendor's standard terms. Items are resolved against the tenant's catalog — a client-pinned token only resolves its OWN client's items and stamps the PO to that client. Use get_reorder_recommendations first to decide what to buy, then create_purchase_orders_from_recommendations to convert a whole reorder sweep in one call; reach for this tool for an explicit, hand-built PO. When the user names an item but not a vendor, resolve the vendor from the item's own sourcing data (its default vendor on list_items, or list_item_sourcing_profiles) rather than guessing from the item's brand or name; only ask when the item has no default vendor or several plausible ones. Max 500 lines per call.

destinationWarehouseId.description: Destination warehouse id (GUID) where the goods will be received.

expectedDate.description: Optional expected delivery date (ISO 8601) — recorded as the PO's due date. When omitted, the due date is today (the tenant's calendar day) plus the effective lead time: the latest line's, from the same cascade the reorder point uses (manual override, the vendor's price book, purchase history, the vendor's default lead time, then a system default).

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: The lines to order (max 500). Each names an item and a quantity.

expense.description: Optional line-level extra charge (shipping/handling), added to the line total. Defaults to the price book's setup cost when the book priced the line, else 0.

itemId.description: Item id (GUID) to order — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the two.

itemSku.description: Item SKU to order. Provide exactly one of itemSku or itemId. Resolved against the tenant's catalog (a client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items).

quantity.description: REQUIRED. Quantity to order (must be greater than zero).

unitCost.description: Agreed unit cost for this line. Omit to price it from the vendor's active price book at this quantity, else the item's catalog cost, else its last purchase cost; the preview names the source.

note.description: Optional free-text note stored on the PO.

paymentTerms.description: Optional payment terms printed on the order (e.g. Net 30). Omit to use the vendor's standard terms.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

supplierId.description: Vendor id (GUID) to buy from — must be an existing vendor on this tenant.

name: create_purchase_order
title: Create Purchase Order
